message.content: Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city. They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family. They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff. The morning air smelled of damp moss. Pebble Spring traced the cracks in the path. A baker waved a warm loaf at the window. The river glistened between the bridges. Children laughed near the fountain. An old mason leaned on his hammer. Pebble Spring watched the mortar set. The roof tiles caught the afternoon light. A sparrow hopped along the eaves. The garden smelled of herbs and rain. Pebble Spring copied the lines in a notebook. The staff hummed with gentle magic. Pebble Spring tried to lift a small stone. It floated for a brief moment. Pebble Spring smiled at the simple wonder. The town bells rang slowly in the square. Pebble Spring listened to the echoes. The walls seemed to breathe with history. Pebble Spring wanted to build carefully. The spring day had grown warm and soft under the pale sun while Pebble Spring wandered through the market with a small basket and a curious smile after watching the builders make their clay spotty that morning.
